primary_protocol: convex combination of individually unit-normalized executable batch gradients; shared radius across conditions
secondary_protocol: rescale each selected combined direction to the same final norm; never reselect weights on audit
reference_selection: fold 0 only; folds 1 and 2 never select units or mixture coefficients
opportunity_gate: Primary SFT: selected mixture uses at least two nonzero units; in both validation folds joint scaled gain and advantage over every single allowed unit exceed the declared minima; audit directional bootstrap gap over the best of all single units has positive lower endpoint; actual primary-radius mixed update improves both targets with positive descriptive intervals and exceeds the discovery-selected best single with a positive descriptive interval. Development evidence only.
strict_singleton_failure: Reported separately; not silently equated to marginal improvement over the best existing single unit.
rl_scope: Analytic expected gradient for the current single-correct-item exact-match reward: p(target)*g_SFT. Not sampled or long RL training.
unit_scope: 64 predefined source-homogeneous random batches plus rec-mean, ground-mean and all-record-mean baselines; not an unrestricted per-record or full-dataset optimum
data_scope: Existing selection and calibration are development data used before; fold changes do not create sealed confirmation. Final test remains untouched.
stop_policy: One fixed discovery/validation pool. Do not resample to obtain a positive result; no new atom method or long training before the primary opportunity gate.
